stay.price_basis: RESORT TENT, double occupancy, per night, not a hotel room. Season is Nov to Feb (official Rann Utsav 2026-27 runs 1 Nov 2026 to 7 Mar 2027; the tent resorts at Dhordo mostly operate only then). One standard tent per private resort: Desert Inn Camp Comfort Tent 4,356 pre-tax with breakfast plus lunch or dinner (EaseMyTrip, no stay dates, 2 guests); Rann Heritage Resort, Dhordo 'Tent 2' 6,252 pre-tax with breakfast, lunch and dinner (EaseMyTrip, no stay dates; room only is 4,687); Great Rann Resort Non-AC tent 7,500 (own website; page does not say per room or per couple, nor what is included). Median of 4,356 / 6,252 / 7,500. Meal plans differ across the three.
stay.notes: Base is Bhuj (about 80 km, 1.5 to 2 hrs); many visitors day-trip from Bhuj hotels instead. Great Rann Resort also lists an AC tent at 8,500. For comparison the official Rann Utsav Dhordo Tent City charges PER PERSON on double occupancy, meals and programmes included, GST extra, Season 1 base rates: Non-AC Swiss Cottage 6,300, Deluxe AC Swiss Cottage 8,300, Premium Tent 9,300, Super Premium 10,300 (a couple pays double; Season 2 adds 2,000 and Season 3 adds 4,000 per person; peak surcharge from one day before full moon). That official tent city is government-run and NOT in the median. Both EaseMyTrip pages carried 'sold out' banners and no dates, so availability is unconfirmed; Cleartrip's Dhordo page showed Desert Inn Camp and Great Rann Resort sold out on 13 Nov 2026 with no price.
